assertions.description: WebTransportError is a constructor whose prototype chain includes DOMException.
new WebTransportError(message, options) keeps the message, options.source and options.streamErrorCode.
assertions.test: (() => { try { const e = new WebTransportError('m', { source: 'session', streamErrorCode: 300 }); return e.message === 'm' && e.source === 'session' && e.streamErrorCode === 300; } catch { return false; } })()

assertions.description: new WebTransportError() has name "WebTransportError", empty message, code 0, source "stream" and streamErrorCode null.
assertions.test: (() => { try { const e = new WebTransportError(); return e.name === 'WebTransportError' && e.message === '' && e.code === 0 && e.source === 'stream' && e.streamErrorCode === null; } catch { return false; } })()

assertions.description: streamErrorCode carries the full unsigned long range: 4294967295 reads back unchanged (no 8-bit narrowing).
assertions.test: (() => { try { return new WebTransportError('x', { streamErrorCode: 4294967295 }).streamErrorCode === 4294967295 && new WebTransportError('x', { streamErrorCode: 256 }).streamErrorCode === 256; } catch { return false; } })()

(() => { try { return new WebTransportError('x', { streamErrorCode: 4294967296 }).streamErrorCode === 4294967295 && new WebTransportError('x', { streamErrorCode: -1 }).streamErrorCode === 0; } catch { return false; } })()

assertions.description: With the standard constructor available, an unknown source enum value throws TypeError.
assertions.test: (() => { try { new WebTransportError('x', { source: 'session' }); } catch { return false; } try { new WebTransportError('x', { source: 'bogus' }); return false; } catch (e) { return e instanceof TypeError; } })()

assertions.description: structuredClone() of a WebTransportError returns a WebTransportError with message, source and streamErrorCode preserved.
assertions.test: (() => { try { const e = new WebTransportError('m', { source: 'session', streamErrorCode: 4096 }); const c = structuredClone(e); return c instanceof WebTransportError && c.message === 'm' && c.source === 'session' && c.streamErrorCode === 4096; } catch { return false; } })()

assertions.description: A null streamErrorCode survives structured cloning as null (not 0).
assertions.test: (() => { try { const c = structuredClone(new WebTransportError('m', { source: 'stream', streamErrorCode: null })); return c instanceof WebTransportError && c.streamErrorCode === null; } catch { return false; } })()

assertions.description: A WebTransportError posted over a MessageChannel arrives as a WebTransportError.
assertions.test: (() => { try { const e = new WebTransportError('m', { source: 'session', streamErrorCode: 9 }); const mc = new MessageChannel(); const p = new Promise((resolve) => { mc.port2.onmessage = (ev) => { resolve(ev.data instanceof WebTransportError && ev.data.source === 'session' && ev.data.streamErrorCode === 9); mc.port1.close(); mc.port2.close(); }; setTimeout(() => resolve(false), 2000); }); mc.port1.postMessage(e); return p; } catch { return false; } })()

assertions.description: Chromium compatibility: the legacy new WebTransportError({message, streamErrorCode}) form keeps working alongside the standard form.
assertions.test: (() => { try { const e = new WebTransportError({ message: 'legacy', streamErrorCode: 7 }); return e.message === 'legacy' && e.streamErrorCode === 7; } catch { return false; } })()
